statements.impact_statement: Oracle Java SE JAXP vulnerability. The advisory fixes Oracle Java SE 21.0.9, while the scanner reported 21.0.8+9-LTS for this image. Liquibase Secure is built from eclipse-temurin:21-jre-noble (docker/Dockerfile:2) and runs the CLI through docker/Dockerfile:68, not an Oracle Java SE or GraalVM client runtime. statements.status_notes: Vulnerability in the Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition product of Oracle Java SE (component: AWT, JavaFX). Easily exploitable vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via multiple protocols to compromise Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition. Successful attacks require human interaction from a person other than the attacker and while the vulnerability is in Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition, attacks may significantly impact additional products (scope change). Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in unauthorized creation, deletion or modification access to critical data or all Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition accessible data.

statements.impact_statement: JDK Security component (resource resolving) vulnerability, part of Oracle's August 2026 CPU. Liquibase Secure is built from eclipse- temurin:21-jre-noble (docker/Dockerfile:2) and never listens on a socket; it is only an outbound network client (HTTPS to license/hub endpoints, TLS JDBC to target databases). Triggering this requires a compromised or MITM'd peer that Liquibase already trusts and connects to -- not exploitable by an arbitrary remote attacker with no foothold on those endpoints. Fixed upstream in Temurin 21.0.12.1+1, but no eclipse- temurin Docker Hub image publishes that build yet as of 2026-09-22 (all noble/jre/jdk tags remain 21.0.12_8); revisit once Temurin ships an updated 21-jre-noble tag.

CVSS 3.1 Base Score 6.8 (Confidentiality impacts). CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:N/A:N).

statements.impact_statement: Oracle Java SE/GraalVM Install-component vulnerability, fixed upstream in 21.0.12 (Oracle August 2026 CPU). The flaw is in Oracle's Java installer, a packaging component that ships only with Oracle's own distribution. Liquibase Secure is built from eclipse-temurin:21-jre-noble (core/docker/Dockerfile:1) via docker-entrypoint.sh (core/docker/docker-entrypoint.sh:8); Temurin's JRE is unpacked from a release archive, not installed through Oracle's installer, so the vulnerable component is not present in the image at all. There is no Adoptium/Temurin tracking entry for this CVE. Unlike the other Oracle Java SE entries in this batch (sandbox/Web Start applicability mismatches, justified requires_environment), this is a component absence -- the installer isn't shipped at all -- hence code_not_present.
